identity.eligibility_criteria: Indian residents aged 18 to 65 years. Digital enrollment without paper forms. Lifelong renewability.
identity.renewal_terms: Guaranteed lifelong renewal with zero claim-based premium loading.
identity.portability_conditions: Portability permitted as per IRDAI portability framework with 45 days prior application.
identity.geographic_availability: Pan-India across all verified healthcare providers.

coverage.inpatient_hospitalization: Covered up to Sum Insured for room, boarding, ICU, doctors, nursing, and medicines with 100% bill payment guarantee (zero deductions).
coverage.daycare_procedures: All daycare procedures covered without 24-hour hospitalization restriction.
coverage.domiciliary_hospitalization: Covered up to Sum Insured when hospital beds are unavailable or patient cannot be moved.
coverage.home_healthcare: Covered for specified treatment procedures under active medical advice.
coverage.ayush_treatment: Covered up to 100% of Sum Insured for inpatient treatment in recognized AYUSH hospitals.
coverage.ambulance_cover: Covered up to actuals for emergency road ambulance. Air ambulance up to ₹5,00,000 per policy year.
coverage.organ_donor_expenses: Covered up to 100% of Sum Insured for harvesting organ from donor.
coverage.modern_treatments: Covered up to Sum Insured for advanced medical treatments and surgical procedures.
coverage.maternity_cover: Covered up to ₹1,00,000 under Platinum variant with reduced 12-month or 24-month waiting period.
coverage.opd_dental_vision: Outpatient consultations and diagnostic tests covered up to specified limits under Platinum add-on.
coverage.restoration_benefit: Unlimited automatic restoration of Sum Insured for unrelated and related illnesses.
coverage.cumulative_bonus: Inflation protect feature with bonus increase in Sum Insured of 10% per year without reduction upon claim.
coverage.wellness_benefits: Free unlimited digital doctor consultations, annual preventive health checkups, and medicine discounts via ACKO App.
coverage.critical_illness_rider: Second medical opinion included from international specialist centers.

permanent_exclusions: Weight loss surgery unless meeting strict life-threatening BMI criteria
Experimental therapies not recognized by medical bodies
restrictions.room_rent_capping: No Room Rent Capping (Any room type: Single Private AC room, Deluxe room, or Suite). Zero proportionate deductions.
restrictions.icu_sub_limit: No Sub-limit on ICU charges (Actuals up to Sum Insured).
restrictions.zone_based_restrictions: Zero zone co-pay across India; standard pricing nationwide.
restrictions.pre_authorization_rules: Cashless pre-auth via ACKO App or hospital cashless desk with instant digital approval within 1 hour.
restrictions.medical_necessity_clause: Treatment must be medically necessary and advised by a registered medical practitioner.
restrictions.non_payable_items: Zero deductions for consumables: ACKO Platinum covers all medical consumables (syringes, gloves, PPE, masks) by default.

premium.pricing_factors: Age of oldest member, sum insured tier, and selected waiting period variant.
premium.tenure_discounts: 10% discount on 2-year tenure; 15% discount on 3-year tenure.
premium.installment_options: Monthly, Quarterly, and Annual payment plans through auto-debit / UPI / credit card.
premium.tax_benefits: Income Tax deduction under Section 80D up to ₹25,000 (individual/family) and ₹50,000 (seniors).
premium.medical_underwriting: Digital tele-underwriting; instant policy issuance for most age profiles without physical health tests.
premium.cancellation_refund_terms: 100% refund during 15-day free-look period. Pro-rata refund upon cancellation thereafter.
optional_riders: Zero Waiting Period for Pre-Existing Diseases Rider

claims.cashless_claim_procedure: Instant cashless approval via ACKO App at 11,500+ network hospitals -> Direct hospital billing -> 100% cashless discharge.
claims.reimbursement_claim_procedure: Upload photos of hospital bills and discharge summary directly through ACKO App -> Settlement processed within 3 days.
required_claim_documents: Digital claim submission via ACKO App
Photograph of Final Hospital Bill with payment receipt
Bank account details (UPI / IMPS for instant transfer)
claims.tpa_support: 100% Direct In-House Claim Settlement (No third-party TPA involved).

governing_regulations: IRDAI Master Circular on Operations and Allied Matters 2024
IRDAI Protection of Policyholders' Interests Regulations
